title: Bound dirty workspace for mixed abelian bit targets
body:
## Summary

A scoped mixed-target extension of the retained augmentation/image-restriction argument:

```text
k paid calls, paid-frame span d, target-frame span s
  -> scalar-projector span <= k-d+s
  -> restrict to <= k-d+s roles, with the same frames and call order
```

For three arbitrary invertible rational 3-by-3 targets in eight calls, the remaining frame spans `d=4,5,6` need at most `7,6,5` total roles respectively. This bounds the previously unbounded dirty-workspace search question. It neither constructs nor excludes an eight-call word.

The new package `research/bit-mixed-target-register-compression/` contains the written proof, constructive exact checker, persisted bases/restricted operators, source pins, task card, controls and registered replay. Canonical investigation: #2898.

Credit Tuafo's identical-target starting point, Ali Romman/PR468 and the retained eumemic/PR288 and huxint/PR203 lineage, plus woklerx/PR1456 and waynenilsen's arbitrary-register results. This is not another finite-group census or PR2897's rational rank-cut screen.

## Evidence

- Before, the identical-target package explicitly leaves the different-target scalar-span implication open. The proof here gives `dim U <= dim S <= k-d+q <= k-d+s`, using the actual generated lattice and an active/dirty-adapted basis.
- Six exact constructive fixtures and all 5,078 bounded words are replayed; all 244 diagonal endpoints compress. A separate vector-propagation oracle checks every input and restricted basis column. Ten semantic rejection controls and six CLI test groups pass, including normal/optimized relocation, receipt corruption and an implementation mutant reproducing the rejected arbitrary-complement bug.
- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-mixed-target-register-compression` passes. CPython 3.13.5 optimized replay gives the same receipt. All 138 research-workflow tests, Ruff correctness checks and committed-byte preflight pass locally.
- Initial main `a1bfbc677fdcbc2a27a9b3bf6c78cac8fd6da9e2`; submission base `ba3de47290c3882cbbe406db1f657578f7ecda69`. Priority revision 5, selected record and scientific inputs are unchanged. Updated runner/batching guidance was read and checks repeated. Final complete overlap snapshot covers 489 open PRs and 1,565 Discussion records; arbitrary diffs and all closed work are not covered.

The universal result is a written proof, not a conclusion from the fixtures. No independent human or proof-kernel review, full predecessor/selected cold replay, native/hosting/precision admission, physical storage saving or new kappa is claimed. A future construction still needs a screened candidate and a complete paid native/consumer budget. Hosted CI is separate from local evidence.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. This adds only one scoped research package.

**Blast radius:** research. No selected-frontier, inherited source, frozen archive or shared-runner changes.
